verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an account-backed, cloud-synced service, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question, but the evidence documents no sandbox, test mode or isolated non-production environment. Self-hosting (running Ente Auth at localhost) and offline 'Use without backups' mode are adjacent arrangements, not a documented sandbox capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
